## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to a public Issue or clearly explains why no Issue was needed.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff and did not include credentials, private source, customer data, production identity, private paths, or local runtime evidence.
- [ ] I documented security, side-effect, and public-boundary impact.
- [ ] I ran the relevant focused checks and stated what was not tested.
- [ ] I updated documentation when public behavior changed.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the repository MIT License.
- [ ] I will follow the Code of Conduct during review.
